description:
About our brand and products:

Football Wallcharts is a UK-based ecommerce brand with 50,000+ sales across previous football tournaments including the World Cup and Euros. Our 2026 World Cup Wallchart Bundle is a complete 5-item pack — large-format tournament wallchart, 48-nation bunting flags, sweepstake kit, damage-free hanging strips, and a smudge-free branded pen. Available in A1 and A2 across four designs (Stadium Glow, Confetti, England, Scotland) from £17.95 with free UK delivery. Every order is backed by our 30-day Print-Perfect Promise.

What makes us different:

We're the only brand selling a complete tournament bundle rather than just a wallchart. Competitors on Amazon and Etsy sell a single chart — we include five items in one pack at a price that undercuts buying them separately. Backed by 50,000+ proven sales, a 30-day print guarantee, and free UK delivery. Four design variants including England and Scotland editions means there's something for every fan.

How affiliates can earn:

Earn 20% commission on every completed sale. With bundles priced from £17.95 and a pre-order discount currently live, there's strong buyer urgency throughout the campaign window. The tournament runs June 11 – July 19 2026, with Father's Day (June 21) creating a major gifting spike mid-tournament. Commissions are paid on the 1st of each month for the previous month's confirmed sales, with a 30-day hold to cover our refund window.

How to promote us:

Best fit for football, sports, family lifestyle, parenting, and gift guide content. The product works naturally for World Cup preview content, Father's Day gift roundups, office culture pieces, and family activity content. Affiliate codes can be shared via blog, social media, YouTube, newsletters, or cashback platforms. The pre-order offer and tournament deadline give you built-in urgency hooks to drive clicks throughout the campaign window.


Other information:

Pre-order currently live with 20% off — stock arrives 22nd April 2026, tournament kicks off 11th June. This seasonal window is your best promotional period. Cookie duration: 30 days. UK customers only (free UK delivery on all orders). Please only promote using approved methods as listed in our programme terms. For questions contact us at hello@footballwallcharts.com.
payout_period: Commissions are paid on the 1st of each month for all confirmed sales from the previous calendar month. For example, sales made in April will be paid on 1st May.
